messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] INCIDENT INC-2026 — Elevated 5xx spike on /v1/embeddings (us-west). Error rate 12% over 5m (baseline ~0.4%). Paging @Leah M (oncall). Logs/dashboard: https://observability.internal/redwood/incidents/INC-2026

Leah M: Ack — I'm on it. Quick check: embeddings p95 latency ~2x normal, embed-pool GPU CPU ~85%, request queue growing. Any recent deploys? @Samir P you good?

Samir P: No deploys in last 30m. Seeing large batches and lots of retries from a couple of orgs (acme-corp + sandbox orgs). Looks like a traffic surge + heavy batching.

Leah M: Ok. Live mitigation plan (short): 1) apply per-route/per-org QPS caps for embeddings for heavy orgs, 2) reduce global embeddings burst capacity (throttle), 3) deprioritize rerank for sandbox/dev keys, keep chat prioritized. I'll execute now and monitor for 10m.

Talia R: +1. Rerank is pretty expensive — disabling for sandbox should free immediate capacity.

Leah M: Applying per-org QPS cap for acme-corp and a global soft-cap for embeddings. Running admin call now: 

```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://admin.internal/api/v1/traffic-controls" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_API_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"action":"upsert","scope":"org","org_id":"acme-corp","route":"/v1/embeddings","qps_limit":10}'
```

Leah M: Also applying global route cap to reduce burst: 

```bash
# rdxctl is internal ops tool
rdxctl traffic set --route /v1/embeddings --global-qps 500 --policy degrade
```

Leah M: Done — rule id tc-789 created. Starting 10m mitigation window and watching metrics.

eng-alerts-bot: Rule tc-789 applied (ok). Telemetry: inbound embeddings QPS dropped ~48% within 60s. 5xx% downtrend observed.

Samir P: Seeing errors drop to ~3% and p95 latency trending down. Request retries also decreased. Looks positive.

Customer Success: Notified ACME point-of-contact and informed of temporary throttles; CS asked to report any immediate customer-visible failures.

Talia R: Disabled rerank for orgs tagged 'sandbox' (quick toggle). Payload: 

```http
POST /admin/feature-toggle
{ "feature":"rerank", "scope":"org_tag", "tag":"sandbox", "state":"off" }
```

Talia R: Disabled — verified by feature flag service. Rerank QPS for sandbox dropped to ~0.

Leah M: After 10m: errors ~1.2%, embed-pool CPU ~62%, queue length normalized. Outcome: mitigation effective. Next steps: keep per-org caps for 1h, schedule platform investigation on batching heuristics and KV cache pressure.

Leah M: Handoff — I'm handing to @Talia R for the next 60m to watch metrics and customer tickets. If things regress escalate to Jin (platform). I created #INC-2026-update and added actions to the incident runbook.

Talia R: Taking over. I'll monitor dashboards, check affected API keys (ACME + sandbox), and keep CS looped. Leaving note in runbook: affected routes: /v1/embeddings (throttled, rule tc-789), /v1/rerank (disabled for sandbox), chat unchanged.

Jin (platform): If you want, I can provision a short-term extra embed pool in us-west to support very heavy paying customers while we tune batching. Ping me if needed.

Leah M: Thanks — for now we keep throttles. Reopen paging if metrics regress. :thumbsup:

Talia R: I'll also add remediation ticket to track longer-term: per-endpoint dynamic quotaing, better backpressure on huge batch sizes, and route-level fair-share to avoid single org blast radius.

Leah M: Closing the page — monitoring in passive mode. Will follow up in postmortem with timelines and customer impact summary.
